description: Source-alignment record between the Claude skills in this repo and the Codex plugin port in email-love/codex-agents. Its job is to stop a fix from landing in one surface and silently never reaching the other. Update it whenever either surface ships a change that the other should mirror, and stamp lastAlignmentReview when you have checked the two are in sync.

codexPlugin.note: v3.0.1 ported the model-choice guidance (c0719be) and the Portsmouth batch 1 fixes (0c67f86) from the Claude skills. v3.0.0 originally repackaged the flat AGENTS.md workflows as a progressively loaded plugin with two skills.

drift.summary: ESP migration v1 commit 1: audit skill no longer assumes Figma. New Step 0 source selector, plus a Local Folder Source adapter with Discover, Fetch, and audit-step adaptations. Report shape for non-Figma sources is deliberately slimmer. Klaviyo and Customer.io adapters land in commits 2 and 3 of the v1 series.
drift.codexStatus: Not yet ported. Wait until all three v1 source adapters (local folder, Klaviyo, Customer.io) land on Claude side, then port as one Codex commit. Codex's single migration skill covers both audit and conversion, so all three source adapters go into a new references/sources/ folder for progressive disclosure.

drift.summary: Portsmouth batch 1 fixes across converter and audit skills. Converter: mandatory mobile-decision checkpoint that runs on every module (not only when a mobile twin exists), concrete visual tells for the mj-group rule, step 5 verification that fails on missing stacking decisions, mobile-width screenshot in the visual check, and wrapper instance sizing (FIXED not FILL, on the component and every instance). Audit: lockup rows added to the recognized build-constraints vocabulary.
drift.codexStatus: Ported in v3.0.1 (codex-agents commit daea242). Landed in the single migration skill (module-conversion.md, foundations.md, audit.md).

drift.summary: Model-choice guidance added to all three skills: strongest available model for Path B / migration-audit / eds-converter (one-time, high rule-count work), a faster model for routine Path A campaign builds.
drift.codexStatus: Ported in v3.0.1 (codex-agents commit daea242) on both codex skills, kept model-agnostic (talks about 'strongest available model or reasoning-effort setting' rather than naming Claude models).

drift.summary: Stop-and-resume rules (never stop silently, do not pause mid-batch, name the state file) and the builder wrong-file guard.
drift.codexStatus: Content-equivalent already present in the Codex repo via its own edit before v3.0.0 packaging. No port owed; the provenance pin above is simply one commit stale on paper.

drift.codexStatus: Claude-repo-specific. This is GitHub release and marketplace plumbing for the Claude skills and has no equivalent in the Codex plugin.

renderSpecIsCanonical: The render rules (structure.md and references/render-spec.md here) are the single source of truth. The Codex plugin carries mirrored copies. When a render rule changes, change it here first, then regenerate the Codex references rather than hand-editing them, so the two cannot disagree.
